title: Treaty of The Hague (1625)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of The Hague (1625)", at revision 1381669200, opens: "The Treaty of The Hague (1625), also known as the Treaty of Den Haag, was signed on 9 December 1625 between England, the Dutch Republic and Denmark-Norway." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q763198, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty signed on 9 December 1625 between England and the Dutch Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
